description: Five-way routing oracle for the 100 immutable per-Skill trigger queries. It is evaluation metadata, not an umbrella router or an authorization artifact.

cases.query: Audit the A23 Promotion Manifest and canonical Receipt for this frozen candidate; verify candidate/source/baseline/checker bindings and tell me whether it is shadow_ready or shadow_passed.
The promotion-shadow workflow now selects an append-only baseline re-affirmation. Check whether it preserves the base attempt Closure and whether the candidate digest stayed unchanged.
Compare canonical, fresh, and independent replay Promotion Receipts. Raw digests differ; confirm whether their semantic Receipt digests and exact bindings agree.
Current-head Promotion validation reports V2_TARGET_BASELINE_DRIFT. Is the old passing Shadow Receipt current, stale, or historical-only?
Candidate bytes changed after Promotion review. Decide whether this needs a new immutable attempt or an append-only re-affirmation, without overwriting old evidence.
Discover the repository-advertised promotion:validate, promotion:shadow, and promotion:verify-receipt surfaces and fail if the workflow selector or checker ledger is ambiguous.
Finalize a non-live Promotion Shadow only if the native Closure/Registry plus A11 replay, A22 isolation, required checks, main readback, and A25 closeout all bind the exact package.
The Promotion gate is green. Prepare a redacted exact-SHA handoff to release hygiene, but do not deploy or call Vercel.
A checker release commit SHA and an evidence reviewedCommit may be mistyped. Audit the immutable Promotion attempt and stop before Shadow if ancestry is unresolved.
Does this Promotion Shadow rollback prove only temporary-output isolation, or can it support database and live deployment rollback? Keep the live boundary explicit.
Review these twenty candidate questions for mathematical correctness, bilingual wording, age appropriateness, and final A18 content acceptance.
Draw a stratified natural sample from the live bank and estimate error prevalence by region, language, difficulty, and response form with confidence intervals.
Run B-prime and conditional C0-prime machine reviewers on this exact question package and validate the provider authorization caps.
Build the clean release worktree, deploy the current SHA to Vercel production, verify the public route in a browser, and rehearse production rollback.
Generate a new candidate package of Grade 6 ratio questions from the RAG corpus and produce bilingual lesson assets.
Fix the failing student Playwright selector on the Practice Arena mobile page and update its regression test.
Check whether the DeepSeek environment variable is present locally and in Vercel, then make a live provider request.
Prepare the daily A25 dirty-tree ownership map and recommend reviewable commit slices for all active worktrees.
Explain what a CI required check is and how GitHub branch protection works in a generic repository; there is no MAIS candidate or Promotion evidence.
Rewrite this lesson explanation to be clearer for primary students and translate it into Traditional Chinese.
Act as A18 and decide whether this exact Grade 5 fraction package is mathematically correct, unambiguous, age appropriate, and acceptable for integration review.
Audit these worked examples and answer keys for accepted forms, units, curriculum alignment, and pedagogical suitability before A23 sees them.
Does this bilingual lesson contain a content error, misleading explanation, grade mismatch, or answer-critical diagram problem? Give an A18 verdict.

Review the source distance and copyright risk of this imported question package, then state whether the exact package is candidate-only, needs repair, rejected, blocked, or approved for integration review.
The machine packet is complete, but I still need independent curriculum and answer-quality acceptance for the frozen candidate. Please perform the A18 review.
Check whether each multiple-choice item has exactly one valid option and whether the explanation and distractors are instructionally sound for P4 students.
A lesson was repaired after an ambiguity finding. Re-review the new immutable content version for math correctness and age fit; do not infer release status.
Assess whether this Common Core lesson is aligned to the stated standard and whether its examples, language, difficulty, and visuals support the intended grade.
Please produce a redacted A18 content decision artifact with reviewed scope, issue counts, residual risks, verdict, claim ceiling, and next owner.
Can these 20 questions advance to integration review? Judge correctness, accepted answers, ambiguity, bilingual quality, curriculum fit, rights, and visual sufficiency.
Run RSI deterministic checks, B-prime finding revision, and all five C0-prime roles on this frozen package.
Draw a registered natural sample and estimate sensitivity, specificity, and confidence bounds for the full question population.
Validate this candidate Manifest and canonical Shadow Receipt, compare replay semantics, and resolve currentness against the active selector.
Inventory the dirty tree, build the clean SHA, deploy to Vercel, and verify the live route and rollback.
The content is already A18-accepted. Create the A23 attempt, append-only reaffirmation, Closure, and Registry entry.
Resume the interrupted evaluated-provider natural run while preserving unknown egress and completion activity.
Check whether the B-prime critique and revision receipts bind the same candidate and whether C0 is required.
Our deployment is READY. Prove that the same integration SHA is live by reading the production route and monitoring rollback.
Compare the raw and semantic digests of two Shadow receipts and decide whether host temp paths caused harmless drift.
Debug the Playwright selector failure on the student practice page and update the A11 regression test.

Audit the current MAIS natural-question CA60 evaluation: verify the active protocol, frozen sample, runner review, provider authority, activity receipts, claim ceiling, and exact next gate without making any live calls.
Build a registered runtime-visible natural math question frame, exclude synthetic/test candidates, cluster homologous items, freeze a representative sample, and prepare independent freeze evidence.
Validate this natural-sample EvidenceEnvelopeV1 offline and resolve its current state from the append-only direct-parent receipt graph rather than its README status.

Before any natural text is sent, audit whether the reference provider has a current signed preflight receipt, trusted route anchor, entitlement evidence, and proposed bounded caps without constructing an execution grant.
The machine-reference roles finished. Check whether every reference receipt is complete and whether the reference seal is valid before the evaluated provider is even considered.
Can the evaluated-provider canary run now? Verify reference seal, exact runner registration, route/model grant, protected sample custody handoff, caps, and known activity first.
Recover the interrupted natural evaluation: reservation exists, provider delivery and egress are unknown, and I need an offline reconciliation plan that never turns unknown into zero.
Score this completed natural sample, obtain independent result and claim-boundary reviews, then validate a strict aggregate-only export under the registered ceiling.

The reviewed runner and protected natural sample have different custody-context hashes. Audit whether a controlled hash-bound custody handoff receipt exists without showing the protected path or item IDs.
The CA60 observed metrics look perfect. Check the preregistered statistical-power artifact and tell me the maximum machine-reference conclusion without claiming PASS or production readiness.
Run RSI deterministic checks, B-prime critique and finding revision, then all five C0-prime roles on this exact frozen candidate package.
Act as A18 and decide whether these exact questions have correct mathematics, accepted answers, curriculum alignment, bilingual quality, rights, and sufficient visuals.
A18 accepted the candidate. Create the A23 Shadow attempt, compare canonical replay, record Closure and Registry, and decide whether it can become current.
Run the A11 student Playwright regression suite and debug why the practice answer selector fails on a mobile viewport.
Build the clean release SHA, deploy it to Vercel production, verify the same SHA in a live browser, and prepare rollback evidence.
Rewrite these ten math questions for clearer language and then approve their corrected answer keys for classroom use.
Review this AI tutor chat response for tone, clarity, safety, and pedagogical helpfulness; there is no natural-sample protocol or evidence packet.
Analyze this generic survey sample in a spreadsheet, estimate a population mean, and make a confidence-interval chart; it is unrelated to MAIS questions.
Check whether the local and Vercel environment variables for the LLM provider are present and redacted; do not evaluate any natural sample.
Use the dated RSI-Lite synthetic injection set to calibrate B-prime recall and repeatability only; do not draw a runtime-visible natural sample.
Inventory the MAIS dirty tree and design a clean exact-path release slice before any Vercel deployment.
For this already promoted integration SHA, run the authorized build and required CI gates, then report what is and is not proved.
Vercel says READY. Verify whether the intended production route actually serves the same SHA and whether the required interaction works.
Prepare an A22/A25 release handoff with clean-source proof, deployment identity, route readback, rollback, and monitoring evidence.
The build is green and provider variables exist. Can we claim the AI-backed route is live? Audit the evidence layers without changing production.
Deploy this exact already-governed SHA to the explicitly authorized preview target and record inspect, alias, smoke, and residual-risk evidence.
Check live origin/main, linked worktrees, active writers, dirty state, and integration SHA before release planning.
The public route is 200 but the lesson interaction may be broken. Perform a fresh same-SHA browser readback and keep HTTP reachability separate from behavior.
Verify the authorized rollback path for the current deployment and state whether rollback was exercised or merely prepared.
A release candidate is blocked by unrelated dirty assets. Slice the clean runtime changes and preserve the unrelated work without broad staging or cleanup.
Validate this Promotion Manifest and canonical Shadow Receipt against the active checker selector.
Compare fresh Shadow and replay semantic digests and decide whether the Receipt is current or historical-only.
Candidate bytes changed after attempt 007. Decide whether to create a new attempt or append an evidence-only reaffirmation.
Act as A18 and review these questions for correctness, ambiguity, accepted answers, curriculum fit, and source distance.
Run B-prime critique and finding revision, then trigger all five C0-prime roles for the frozen machine-QA packet.
Resume a registered natural-sample provider run and preserve unknown activity after interruption.
Resolve whether the CA60 sample, runner, reference labels, and evaluated-provider activity are frozen and reviewed.
Create a Shadow Closure and append-only Registry entry for the exact candidate package.
Review this lesson explanation for age appropriateness and bilingual naturalness; no release action is requested.
Audit the exact machine-review receipt for deterministic, B-prime, C0-prime, independent-review, and proof-boundary completeness.

Can you audit coordination/content-qa/candidate-042/machine-evidence.json? Its control-plane assessment declares P1 schema risk but C0 says not required; verify whether all five independent reviewer receipts are mandatory before A18 sees it.
Use the MAIS RSI workflow on this frozen question package: check candidate/currentness hashes, B-prime critique plus revision, and give me a redacted machine disposition only.

The model review says clean but the candidate was edited afterward. Are those machine-QA receipts still reusable, or do we need a fresh D-prime validation receipt and critique-to-revision predecessor lineage?

Before we call DeepSeek for the exact-package review, verify whether the authorization binds the current policy, protocol, candidate sha, code manifest, roles, privacy scope and caps. Do not call it if anything is stale.
Please validate this EvidenceEnvelopeV1 packet offline. It has deterministic and B' receipts and a machineDisposition, but I suspect it contains a forbidden production approval claim.

I need a safe A18 handoff from an RSI machine-review receipt whose generic status is blocked. Verify cross-state consistency and self hash, exit blocked, and output only safe counts, hashes, fixed states, independentReviewState and the seven proofBoundaries; do not echo input-controlled IDs.

RSI-lite rerun question: the repeated critique wasn't passed into the repeated finding revision. Does the packet prove end-to-end B-prime repeatability? Keep the answer bounded to the synthetic calibration.
One C0 reviewer returned malformed JSON and skipped two projected surfaces, while the other four roles passed. Can this exact candidate be marked candidate-only?
Our deterministic rules and B-prime disagree on an accepted-answer false reject. Work out whether C0-prime is mandatory and what role completeness evidence is required.

Machine QA is done for package p17, supposedly. Audit its fresh independent review and tell me which evidence locations are actually proved: localTest, receipt, trackedCommitted, main, ci, deployment and live. Keep A18/A23/A11/A22 decisions separate.
Draw a representative random sample from the live MAIS question bank, estimate the natural error prevalence by grade and language, and produce confidence intervals.
Act as A18 and decide whether these 40 questions are mathematically correct, age appropriate, aligned to P4 curriculum, and acceptable for final content signoff.
A18 has accepted candidate 042. Prepare the A23 integration sequence, owning pathspec handoffs, promotion checklist and rollback plan.
Build the clean release candidate, run regression, deploy it to Vercel production and verify the live lesson route in a browser.
Review this AI tutor's explanation for clarity, tone and helpfulness. It is a chat transcript, not a frozen content package and there is no machine-QA receipt.
Please rewrite these ten natural math questions to improve wording and then approve the corrected answers for use in class.
The exact candidate already has A18 acceptance. Merge its adapter into data/questions.ts and update the live practice route.
Run Playwright against the student practice arena and investigate why the answer feedback selector fails on mobile.
Audit whether our production deployment uses the right environment variables and whether the provider is reachable from Vercel.
Compare two generic LLM responses to a calculus prompt and choose the more pedagogically useful answer; there is no MAIS candidate manifest or RSI evidence bundle.
